name: Australia
standard: WCAG 2.2 AA (latest WCAG version, via Digital Service Standard Criterion 3)

laws.summary: Prohibits disability discrimination in providing goods, services and facilities, including online services.
Referenced by DSS Criterion 3 as legislation agencies must consider.

policy_docs.title: DSS Criterion 3: Leave no one behind
AHRC — Standards and guidelines for digital accessibility

applies_to: DSS: non-corporate Commonwealth entities' public and staff-facing informational and transactional services. DDA: all service providers.

deadlines.what: DSS v2.0 applies to new services of non-corporate Commonwealth entities
DSS v2.0 applies to existing public-facing services

requires: Apply the latest WCAG (2.2) at AA
Test with users who depend on assistive technology
Test across devices and platforms before launch
Offer multiple content formats and human-validated multilingual critical information
mobile: implied — DSS requires testing across the devices and platforms users use; the DDA is technology-neutral.
procurement: Commonwealth ICT procurement uses AS EN 301 549 (not verified here).
enforcement: DSS compliance is via DTA assurance; DDA complaints go to the Australian Human Rights Commission, then the federal courts.
